name: zoom
description: Reads Zoom users, meetings, webinars, bounded module-specific data, and SCIM2 groups/users through the Zoom REST API; includes sensitive Cobrowse SDK and SCIM2 reads, approval-gated Chatbot, SCIM2, clinical-note, and Quality Management actions, and a redacted Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key action.

risk.read: external Zoom API read of user, meeting, webinar, Quality of Service, AI Companion, My Notes, healthcare clinical-note, Quality Management, Cobrowse SDK session, and SCIM2 user/group data
risk.write: typed Zoom Chatbot message, Link Unfurls, SCIM2 group/user, healthcare clinical-note, and Quality Management actions, plus Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival key decryption with redacted output
